about: Copies a value and says so for a moment. The trigger draws no look of its own, so a page draws it as a button.

alone.about: Press it. The indicator holds both marks and swaps on the state the machine publishes, then swaps back after a timeout, so the button says it worked without anything else on the page having to.
alone.title: On its own

beside.about: Beside the value it copies, so a reader sees what they are about to take. The field is read-only rather than disabled: it can still be focused and selected, which is the fallback where the browser refuses the copy.
beside.title: Beside a field

held.about: How long the mark stays before the button goes back to offering the copy. Press both. The default three seconds is long enough that a reader who looked away still catches it, and a quarter of a second is over before the eye returns.
held.title: How long it says so

label: Link to the payout

own.about: A control the page draws itself, reading the state and the copy method off the machine. Reach for this where the trigger is not a plain button, or where the words change with the state.
own.title: Your own control

sizes.about: The labelled row at every size. The size steps the label and the gaps, and the field and the button read their own size beside it.
sizes.title: Sizes

title: Clipboard

value.about: The value itself as the thing pressed. Reach for this where the copy is a convenience rather than the point of the row.
value.title: The value itself
